page.overview:
Who is Deputy Graham?

Graham is a Deputy for the Warren County Sheriff's Department.

Graham, along with Barker and another of his colleagues, responded to a crime scene which consisted of 10 firefighters and Police Officers Francis and Richards. He went to the hospital to interview Allyson telling him that Michael is alive. He along with his other colleagues put the hospital on lockdown and Tommy and the mob did not agree with it. He was later seen controlling the mob when they were chanting "EVIL DIES TONIGHT". Category:Halloween Kills characters Category:Law Enforcement Category:Male characters Category:Minor characters
